book.name: Jeims
book.title: Jeims na letama tauwai sumaḡa matabudi ḡarodie

content: Waiguyau banegimima ko kita kauana
Taumi banaga waiguyaumima yodi koi beavaia kauana. Taumi tokare piripiri ko banavidina, vutuna aubainama yodi koi nuaboya kaua be ko ḡabana.
Taumi ami waiguyauma matabuna a bova be kwarikwari ami garama a kanidina.

Ami manema niranira a kanidi be a raubusabusaḡana. Be inam raubusebuseḡinama tokare ei maḡatarana da taumi keda koya parena. Be inam niraniranama taumi mate tubuḡimima tokare e kani rovo be gienae kai e kara gorumina. Raḡan damonama kaiteka e tavatavana, be taumi uma taragai be mane kowai dam raka yababena.
Ko kita! Taumi ami taunoyama ami sipie a noyanoya be nam kowai maesidina, vutuna aubainama adi bekurama yodi Bada wairewapana vavasaḡinama e vaivaiena.

Taumi dobue yaba toitoi tabutabu koyai dam raka yababedi be taumiḡa kowai nuaverena. Taumi koya kani kapoteu be moraba ko nuanua sarisarina, taumi maika bawa tokare raḡan damone ta vunuḡimi be ta nigomina.
Taumi banaga veredima koyai tara tautauedi be koya vunuḡidina, avedi da taudi nam aba gewagewanama ḡaromie ti voiena.
Koi raba nuetau be ko moiragina
Yau bana, koi raba nuetauna naumeki da Bada e verau munaḡana. Tausipi ko noḡoti, tauna ewai raba nuetauna da kusana e dobi da kani ta gogo be maura e tubuḡana.
Be teneḡinama nama taumi mate. Koi raba nuetau be piripiri raḡandie ko midi da bagibaginaḡa, baninama Bada na kaba verauma kaiteka maida.
Be nam ami banagama mate koi suramudu, avedi, inam kauine tokare Bada e kovoḡimina. Baninama tauwai tarapiri tauna kaiteka maida.
Yau bana, peroperoveta ko noḡotidi, taudi piripiri be wainuatoitoi raḡandie ai nuabagibagi be Bada isane a giugiuna.

Mamaitua inam nama banegidima yai aiainidina, baninama taudi piripiri nopodie nam ti bekuna, be ai nuabagibagina. Joub ko noḡoti. Tauna piripiri dosidima ya banavina be yaḡoro yai nuabagibagina. Vutuna aubainama Bada yai aiainina, baninama Bada tauna raunuatoi baneginama.
Waisaḡina be rausaḡi adi giuma

Be mate, yau bana, nam ko rausaḡi. Nam mara banegidima isedie, bo dobu bo yaba ḡesaudima isedie ko rausaḡi, avedi. Taumi deḡoda koi aninana, naumeki da koi anina ḡomana, be deḡoda tuaḡai, naumeki da ko tuaḡai ḡomana. Nam i verena deḡoda tokare etare ko midi be gewagewa dosinama ko banavina.
Waisumaḡe ko moiragi
Deḡoda tam aitau kwawai nuatoitoina, naumeki da kwa moiragina. Be deḡoda tam aitau kwawai nuaverena, naumeki da tam kwa sare be Bada isanama kwa kaisuḡusuḡuna.
Deḡoda tam aitau kuya sidana, naumeki da ekalesia babadidima kwa riuedi da Bada isane aubaimma ta moiragi be oeri debame ta ḡinina.
Be moiragi waisumaḡe, tokare Bada inam baneginama sidasidanama ei yawasanina. Be deḡoda inam baneginama ḡarone gewagewa, naumeki da Bada tokare inam baneginama na gewagewama e noḡota porena.

Vutuna aubainama ami banabanagama mate ami gewagewama koi kawa kuvesa be ko moiragi vivirana, yodibe taumi tokare ko yawasanana. Be didimana baneginama na moiragima inam yai rewapana kaua be bani biribiridima.

Elaija ko noḡoti, tauna banaga ḡoma maika tauda. Be tauna nuanama tabutabune marakapo aubainama ya moiragina da nam sibo kusana ya dobi. Be inam raḡanine kusana nam i dobina naumeki da modi rabuiteḡa be nawaravi 6 a kovina.
Muriḡa ya moiragi munaḡa da kusana ya ḡoḡo, be dubue kani a tubuḡana.
Yau bana, taumi deḡoda aitau tenaḡa ḡaromie riukaua waimuriwatenenama sibo i gose be tam aitau inam baneginama ku verauḡa munaḡena Bada ḡarone, tam inam voia verenama kuya voiena,

baninama uma ko noḡoti, tam aitau da gewagewa baneginama tauna gewagewa kedane ya naḡonaḡo be tam kuya verauḡa munaḡena, tam inam baneginama gurie be kuyai yawasana munaḡena. Be na gewagewama toitoi Mamaitua ya noḡota poredina.
